The '''Embass suit''' was a living suit created by [[Viull Gorsat]], a member of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], using [[Yuuzhan Vong]] bioforming technology. It was created from the [[Stomach/Legends|stomach]] of a [[Crustacean/Legends|crustacean]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. Its lining supplied [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] from the surrounding atmosphere to the wearer's skin while removing toxins from it, allowing the wearer to survive inside the living suit. It had a lifespan of less than a [[Standard week|week]], as its body mass did not contain enough nutrients to sustain it. However, constantly spraying it with [[Water/Legends|water]] and keeping it out of direct sunlight lengthened its lifespan. A vertical slit in its chest provided entry into the suit, while the head split in the middle after a mechanism under the jaw was pulled. Two [[Coral/Legends|coral]] [[Ruby/Legends|rubies]] shaped into horns adorned the head as decoration. To further add to the illusion, a child's [[noisemaker]] was reconfigured by Wraith [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Thaymes Fodrick]] and embedded inside the suit to simulate multiple heartbeats.<ref name="MK" />

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Voort saBinring]], leader of the Wraiths, ordered Gorsat to create the suit as part of their [[Mission to Kuratooine|mission]] to expose the corrupt Galactic Alliance [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]. Their ruse involved [[Turman Durra]], the Wraith's [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Actor/Legends|actor]], wearing the Embass suit and pretending to be "Embassy-Who-Climbs", an unidentified creature recently awakened from the depths of Kuratooine's [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]. Embassy-Who-Climbs mission was to meet with the planetary leader, Thaal, and lure him into the planet with the promise of a massive quantity of gems as a gift.<ref name="MK" />
